hero.title:
Build Go APIs with
Architecture that Scales
hero.subtitle: Ginject brings NestJS-inspired dependency injection to Go. Module-based architecture, deterministic cancellation, zero goroutine leaks.

features.title: Everything you need
features.subtitle: Production-grade primitives built into the framework

di.title: Dependency Injection
di.desc: NestJS-inspired Module→Controller→Provider pattern with reflection-based auto-injection. No tags, no annotations.

exec.title: Execution Context
exec.desc: Every request carries a cancellable context.Context with metadata and hierarchical SLA timeouts. WS connections get their own root context.

goroutine.title: Zero Goroutine Leaks
goroutine.desc: GoSafe launcher checks ctx.Done() before spawning. All WS goroutines are lifecycle-safe and cancel when the connection closes.

ws.title: WebSocket Native
ws.desc: WS controllers with event-based routing. Per-connection ExecutionContext, per-message SLA timeouts, and clean shutdown.

middleware.title: Pipeline Architecture
middleware.desc: Composable middleware, guards, interceptors, and exception filters — global or per-route. Built-in CORS, Helmet, CSRF, RequestLogger.

cache.title: Built-in Cache
cache.desc: Sharded in-memory LFU cache with TTL, SetNX atomic operations, Keys/TTL introspection, and a pluggable interface.

footer.madeWith: Made with love for the Go community
